where: rule-sumSt · World Eaters · Goretrack Onslaught rule · Rush to the Fray
why: GW "Each time a WORLD EATERS unit … disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, add 1 to Charge rolls made for that unit …". Its stat box has the disembark condition and reach World Eaters. Closes my round-1 note.

Table rows read as option sentences (Blessings of Khorne) and a bullet's "**Name:**" as its option (Surging Vitality). Per the builder's BOXES diff only the 4 named stat boxes are new; LS now accepts a table row's sentence as the quote. Re-rolls are not read: the chargeAdd/advanceAdd patterns need "add N"/"has +N".

Patterns need a number added or subtracted, so no re-roll is read as a roll change (Battle-lust's re-roll, Bloody Fury and the others listed have no box). The foe test now leaves "this unit has +1" (The Scent of Blood) as its own. The 4 new stat boxes fall back (reader2 does not read Charge): AGREE 61→65, nothing counted, each drawn from its words with its summary. (Round 2: The Scent of Blood has both sentences as snc entries; see we2|scent-of-blood-snc.)

"For each X this model is equipped with" is read as an addition per X, counted after swaps (swaps come before adds in acts). A name-alone alternative is read as one of it. A swap of "X and Y" counts gear of the swap's model. "later" holds Split models. A choice with nothing read is unread, never empty. I reran from-waha.js for world-eaters and chaos-daemons in a scratch copy: no WARGEAR OPTIONS left unread.
